label: Temporal Denoise
blurb: Cleans grain and sensor noise by comparing each frame with the frames before it instead of blurring it. Noise is different in every frame and the picture is not, so wherever an earlier frame matches, it is averaged in and the fizz settles out while edges, text and fine texture stay as sharp as they were. Anything that moves too much is left alone rather than smeared. Follow lets it track slow drift and handheld wobble.
